name: IG30TPY Water Transparency Sensor
shortDescription: Transmitted-light measurement provides water transparency and temperature readings without chemical reagents. A compact digital probe with an automatic cleaning brush supports online monitoring in surface waters, river channels and aquaculture, helping limit deposits on the optical surface.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆ Small size, easy installation, small long-term monitoring data drift, good stability
◆ Measurable transparency and temperature parameters
◆ Comes with a cleaning brush to prevent impurities and microorganisms from adhering
◆ Maintenance free, long service life, low usage cost
Application areas:
Surface water, river channels, black and odorous water bodies, aquaculture water bodies
Technical parameters:
Range: 0~500cm
Measurement principle: Transmitting light method
Measurement accuracy: ± 5%
Repeatability: less than ± 5%
Sensor material: Body: SUS316L or titanium alloy; Window: Sapphire
Self cleaning: automatic scraping brush
Sensor communication: MODBUS RS-485 
Storage temperature:- 10~50℃ 
Working temperature: 0~50 ℃ (non freezing)
Protection level: IP68 
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Sensor size: 212mm * 50mm
